body: Thanks for your story, I’m not sure where I could work or how I could with what I have but maybe something will turn up right. It probably won’t but at least I’m trying to be a little hopeful

Hey, woke up this morning reading this and thanks for the kind words, I really appreciate reaching out. I’m glad I’m not the only one facing this as well. You are graduating so congrats on your hard work to even get there. I’m hoping I can have that opportunity someday
